description.p: Fluorine Manager is a Linux port of Mod Organizer 2, a powerful mod management tool for Bethesda games and other titles. It uses a virtual filesystem to isolate ordinary mod deployment while allowing complex mod setups with load order management, conflict resolution, and profile support. Its optional Root Builder temporarily deploys and then restores files that must live in the game directory.

ul.li: Virtual filesystem isolation with optional managed game-root deployment
Profile system for different mod configurations
Proton/Wine prefix management for running Windows games
